labReproduced.message: You cannot perform the requested operation, required scopes are missing in the token.

The principal does not have any one of the required Microsoft Graph permissions: AuditLog.Read.All to call this API. For more information about Microsoft Graph permissions, please visit https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/permissions-overview.
Insufficient privileges to complete the operation.
